The integration with Apple Reminders is fantastic. I can see my work and personal calendars and my to do’s all in one place. I can schedule meetings as well as time block for what activities I want to focus on at different times of the day (since I don’t have the same schedule M-F week after week like I used to), and refer to my lists of reminders to know what is highest priority to focus on during those blocks. If I don’t complete something it will automatically carry over to the next day.

Exceptional. I had an issue with the Calendars app by Readdle, and I honestly couldn’t be more impressed with how they handled it. Their support team worked with me step by step until everything was completely resolved. That level of attention and care is rare, and it really changed how I see the app as a whole.

On top of that, I genuinely love using it. The month view is one of the best I’ve seen clean, easy to read, and thoughtfully designed with clear labels that make everything instantly understandable at a glance. It doesn’t feel cluttered like a lot of other calendar apps.

The natural language input is another standout feature. Being able to type something like “Lunch with John tomorrow at noon” and have it instantly understood and scheduled correctly just feels effortless and intuitive. It removes friction and makes adding events feel quick and natural instead of tedious.

Between the excellent design and the outstanding customer support, this app easily stands out from the competition for me. It’s clear that a lot of thought and care went into both the product and the user experience.
